answer: We model a decentralized protocol where identity creation requires a dynamic opportunity-cost bond validated via a velvet fork. By anchoring each identity to a zero-knowledge verifiable delay kernel, the subgame-perfect slashing matrix imposes a devastating penalty P that dominates any potential reward R. Consequently, for any sable adversary deploying n identities, the expected payoff E[U] = R - (n * P) is strictly negative, forcing a unique and robust Nash equilibrium where honest signaling is the only rational strategy.
